said: July eighth. Iran attacks three ships in Hormuz.

said: The US strikes more than eighty targets.

said: Iran's Revolutionary Guards say they hit eighty-five US military sites in Bahrain and Kuwait.

Bitcoin fell about two and a half percent to around 62,000.
said: Bitcoin fell about two and a half percent, to around sixty-two thousand.

said: July thirteenth. Trump says the blockade is coming back, with a toll on ships.

said: In two trading days, Brent crude jumps eleven percent.
